'''Nerf cubes''' was a rich, meaty [[Stew/Legends|stew]] made up of cubic chunks of nerf meat and usually mixed with local tubers. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] partook of nerf cubes and tubers in wine sauce while in [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]].
